name: napkin-sketch
description: Animation Mode and vector drawing for napkin-sketch, packaged for AI tools that load plugins.

plugins.name: vectors
plugins.description: Animation Mode for napkin-sketch, as a plugin: the /vectors:animation-mode command that draws one frame from the form the app writes, an animation-frame subagent that runs the same job in its own context, and the two skills behind them - vector-animations (assemblies, joint pivots, cycle tables, transform recipe) and vector-graphics (Bezier formulas, degree choice, SVG layer structure, and a dependency-free script that derives path data from control points).
